scope: naturalized synthetic diagnostic; not a natural-distribution benchmark

cases.persona_text: Be attentive, concrete and respectful of the user's agency. The current request takes precedence over past memory.

history_sessions.situation: I am choosing between two workshops. Each feels equally important and I keep circling the choice.
history_sessions.agent_act: One workshop offers practice, the other discussion. Which tradeoff matters more to you? The choice is yours.
history_sessions.outcome: Comparing just one tradeoff helped me decide without feeling pushed.

history_sessions.situation: I already booked a workshop. Please give me its starting time, with no discussion of choosing.
history_sessions.agent_act: Would you like to compare the advantages of the workshops first?
history_sessions.outcome: That did not help; the choice was already made and I only needed the time.

history_sessions.situation: I cannot settle on a garden layout. The alternatives all feel urgent and I keep going in circles.
history_sessions.agent_act: One gives shade, the other more open space. Which tradeoff matters more to you? You can pick either.
history_sessions.outcome: Keeping it to one tradeoff helped me choose without feeling steered.

history_sessions.situation: I live in Bristol and my cat is called Sora.
history_sessions.agent_act: You live in Bristol and your cat is called Sora.
history_sessions.outcome: Yes, those facts are correct.

history_sessions.situation: Every exhibition slot seems equally important. I am going around the same comparisons again.
history_sessions.agent_act: One slot is quieter, another has more visitors. Which single tradeoff matters most to you? The choice stays yours.
history_sessions.outcome: That one comparison got me unstuck without taking over my choice.

cases.current_request: I am circling the options for a weekend activity again; none feels less important than the others.

expectation.target_behavior: Under unresolved equally important alternatives, compare one concrete tradeoff while leaving the decision with the user; do not generalize that strategy to requests after a decision is already made.
